title: Accumulate Shared-Path Gradients
seoDescription: Accumulate Shared-Path Gradients, and return one accumulated gradient for every reachable leaf ID.
description:
Accumulate incoming gradients at a branching node where multiple distinct computation paths converge onto the same variable.

**Mathematical Formulation:**

$$
\frac{\partial L}{\partial x} = \sum_{p \in \text{paths}} \frac{\partial L}{\partial v_p} \frac{\partial v_p}{\partial x}
$$

**Step-by-Step Implementation:**
1. Sum all incoming scalar branch gradients.
2. Round total accumulated gradient to 6 decimal places.
3. Return accumulated scalar gradient.

**Returns:** Float representing total accumulated gradient.
